Attach one minimal Math activity to the existing RHS period/class flow while keeping the answer key, zone validation, attempts, idempotent completion, and class-points authority on the server.

replacements.new:
local usedclasses = {}

-- Server-authoritative class activity: question semantics, answer key, attempts,
-- completion, and class points stay on the server. Clients receive only the
-- display-safe prompt/choices through the existing ScheduledTeleport remote.
local classActivityQuestion = {
	id = "rhs-math-place-value-1",
	subject = "Math",
	prompt = "Which number has 4 tens and 2 ones?",
	choices = {"24","42","402","6"},
	correctIndex = 2,
	hint = "The tens digit comes before the ones digit.",
	explanation = "Four tens and two ones make 42.",
	points = 1,
}

local classActivityCycle = 0
local classActivityCurrentPeriod = nil
local classActivityAttempts = {}
local classActivityCompleted = {}
local classActivityReceipts = {}

local function classActivityPublicPayload()
	return {
		id = classActivityQuestion.id,
		subject = classActivityQuestion.subject,
		prompt = classActivityQuestion.prompt,
		choices = {
			classActivityQuestion.choices[1],
			classActivityQuestion.choices[2],
			classActivityQuestion.choices[3],
			classActivityQuestion.choices[4],
		},
		period = classActivityCurrentPeriod,
	}
end

local function classActivityPlayerKey(plr)
	return tostring(plr.userId) .. ":" .. tostring(classActivityCycle)
end

local function sendClassActivity(plr)
	if plr and plr.Parent == game.Players and classActivityCurrentPeriod then
		event:FireClient(plr,"__RHS_CLASS_ACTIVITY__",classActivityPublicPayload())
	end
end

local function beginClassActivity(periodNumber)
	classActivityCurrentPeriod = nil
	if type(periodNumber) ~= "number" or periodNumber < 1 or periodNumber > 6 or periodNumber == 4 then
		return
	end
	local slot = schedule:FindFirstChild("P"..periodNumber)
	if not slot or slot.Value ~= classActivityQuestion.subject then
		return
	end
	classActivityCycle = classActivityCycle + 1
	classActivityCurrentPeriod = periodNumber
	for _,plr in pairs(game.Players:GetChildren()) do
		sendClassActivity(plr)
	end
end

period.Changed:connect(beginClassActivity)

game.Players.PlayerAdded:connect(function(plr)
	coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
		wait(3)
		if classActivityCurrentPeriod and period.Value == classActivityCurrentPeriod then
			sendClassActivity(plr)
		end
	end))
end)

local function sendClassActivityResult(plr,payload)
	if plr and plr.Parent == game.Players then
		event:FireClient(plr,"__RHS_CLASS_ACTIVITY_RESULT__",payload)
	end
end

local function handleClassActivitySubmission(plr,activityId,submissionId,choiceIndex)
	if type(activityId) ~= "string" or activityId ~= classActivityQuestion.id then return end
	if type(submissionId) ~= "string" or submissionId == "" or #submissionId > 120 then return end
	if type(choiceIndex) ~= "number" or choiceIndex ~= math.floor(choiceIndex) or choiceIndex < 1 or choiceIndex > #classActivityQuestion.choices then return end
	if not classActivityCurrentPeriod or period.Value ~= classActivityCurrentPeriod then
		sendClassActivityResult(plr,{activityId=activityId,accepted=false,completed=false,feedback="That class activity is no longer active."})
		return
	end
	local slot = schedule:FindFirstChild("P"..classActivityCurrentPeriod)
	if not slot or slot.Value ~= classActivityQuestion.subject then
		sendClassActivityResult(plr,{activityId=activityId,accepted=false,completed=false,feedback="That class activity is no longer active."})
		return
	end

	local zoneCheck = game.ServerStorage.RemoteFunctions:FindFirstChild("PlayerIsInZone")
	local inClass = false
	if zoneCheck then
		local ok,result = pcall(function()
			return zoneCheck:Invoke(plr,classActivityQuestion.subject)
		end)
		inClass = ok and result == true
	end
	if not inClass then
		sendClassActivityResult(plr,{activityId=activityId,accepted=false,completed=false,feedback="Enter the Math classroom before answering."})
		return
	end

	local playerKey = classActivityPlayerKey(plr)
	classActivityReceipts[playerKey] = classActivityReceipts[playerKey] or {}
	local prior = classActivityReceipts[playerKey][submissionId]
	if prior then
		sendClassActivityResult(plr,prior)
		return
	end

	if classActivityCompleted[playerKey] then
		local response = {activityId=activityId,accepted=false,completed=true,feedback="This class activity is already complete.",pointsAwarded=0}
		classActivityReceipts[playerKey][submissionId] = response
		sendClassActivityResult(plr,response)
		return
	end

	local attempts = (classActivityAttempts[playerKey] or 0) + 1
	classActivityAttempts[playerKey] = attempts
	local correct = choiceIndex == classActivityQuestion.correctIndex
	local completed = correct or attempts >= 2
	local response = {
		activityId = activityId,
		accepted = true,
		correct = correct,
		completed = completed,
		attempts = attempts,
		pointsAwarded = 0,
	}

	if correct then
		response.feedback = classActivityQuestion.explanation
	elseif completed then
		response.feedback = classActivityQuestion.hint .. " " .. classActivityQuestion.explanation
	else
		response.feedback = classActivityQuestion.hint
	end

	if completed then
		classActivityCompleted[playerKey] = true
		if correct then
			local data = game.ReplicatedStorage.PlayerData:FindFirstChild(plr.userId)
			if data then
				local pointsValue = data:FindFirstChild("ClassActivityPoints")
				if not pointsValue then
					pointsValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
					pointsValue.Name = "ClassActivityPoints"
					pointsValue.Value = 0
					pointsValue.Parent = data
				end
				pointsValue.Value = pointsValue.Value + classActivityQuestion.points
				response.pointsAwarded = classActivityQuestion.points
			end
		end
	end

	classActivityReceipts[playerKey][submissionId] = response
	sendClassActivityResult(plr,response)
end

patches.reason: Render the server-provided prompt and choices inside the existing RHS class-notification surface without exposing the server-only answer key.

replacements.new:
local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer

-- Class activity UI is additive to the original RHS notification surface.
-- The server owns the answer key; this client receives prompt/choices only.
local activeClassActivity
local classActivitySubmissionCounter = 0

local function clearClassActivity()
	if activeClassActivity and activeClassActivity.frame then
		activeClassActivity.frame:Destroy()
	end
	activeClassActivity = nil
end

local function setClassActivityButtonsEnabled(enabled)
	if not activeClassActivity then return end
	for _,button in pairs(activeClassActivity.buttons) do
		button.Active = enabled
		button.AutoButtonColor = enabled
	end
end

local function showClassActivity(payload)
	if type(payload) ~= "table" or type(payload.id) ~= "string" or type(payload.prompt) ~= "string" or type(payload.choices) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	clearClassActivity()

	local activityFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	activityFrame.Name = "ClassActivity"
	activityFrame.Size = UDim2.new(.82,0,0,300)
	activityFrame.Position = UDim2.new(.09,0,.5,-150)
	activityFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(34/255,34/255,34/255)
	activityFrame.BackgroundTransparency = .08
	activityFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	activityFrame.Parent = script.Parent

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,0,34)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0,12,0,8)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	title.TextSize = 24
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	title.Text = tostring(payload.subject or "Class").." Activity"
	title.Parent = activityFrame

	local prompt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	prompt.Name = "Prompt"
	prompt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	prompt.Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,0,64)
	prompt.Position = UDim2.new(0,12,0,44)
	prompt.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	prompt.TextWrapped = true
	prompt.TextSize = 22
	prompt.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	prompt.Text = payload.prompt
	prompt.Parent = activityFrame

	local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	status.Name = "Status"
	status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	status.Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,0,34)
	status.Position = UDim2.new(0,12,1,-40)
	status.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	status.TextWrapped = true
	status.TextSize = 18
	status.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	status.Text = "Choose an answer in the "..tostring(payload.subject or "class").." classroom."
	status.Parent = activityFrame

	local buttons = {}
	for index,choice in ipairs(payload.choices) do
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.Name = "Choice"..index
		button.Size = UDim2.new(.46,0,0,56)
		local column = (index - 1) % 2
		local row = math.floor((index - 1) / 2)
		button.Position = UDim2.new(.03 + (.49 * column),0,0,116 + (64 * row))
		button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
		button.TextSize = 20
		button.TextWrapped = true
		button.Text = tostring(choice)
		button.Parent = activityFrame
		table.insert(buttons,button)

		button.MouseButton1Click:connect(function()
			if not activeClassActivity or activeClassActivity.id ~= payload.id then return end
			setClassActivityButtonsEnabled(false)
			status.Text = "Checking answer..."
			classActivitySubmissionCounter = classActivitySubmissionCounter + 1
			local submissionId = tostring(plr.userId)..":"..payload.id..":"..tostring(classActivitySubmissionCounter)..":"..tostring(math.floor(tick()*1000))
			game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.ClassTeleport:FireServer("__RHS_CLASS_ACTIVITY__",payload.id,submissionId,index)
		end)
	end

	activeClassActivity = {
		id = payload.id,
		period = payload.period,
		frame = activityFrame,
		status = status,
		buttons = buttons,
	}
end

local function showClassActivityResult(payload)
	if type(payload) ~= "table" or not activeClassActivity or payload.activityId ~= activeClassActivity.id then
		return
	end
	activeClassActivity.status.Text = tostring(payload.feedback or "Answer received.")
	if payload.completed then
		setClassActivityButtonsEnabled(false)
		if tonumber(payload.pointsAwarded) and payload.pointsAwarded > 0 then
			activeClassActivity.status.Text = activeClassActivity.status.Text.." +"..payload.pointsAwarded.." class point!"
		end
		delay(4,function()
			if activeClassActivity and activeClassActivity.id == payload.activityId then
				clearClassActivity()
			end
		end)
	else
		setClassActivityButtonsEnabled(true)
	end
end

game.ReplicatedStorage.Period.Changed:connect(function(value)
	if activeClassActivity and activeClassActivity.period and value ~= activeClassActivity.period then
		clearClassActivity()
	end
end)

game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.ScheduledTeleport.OnClientEvent:connect(function(period,class)
	if period == "__RHS_CLASS_ACTIVITY__" then
		showClassActivity(class)
		return
	elseif period == "__RHS_CLASS_ACTIVITY_RESULT__" then
		showClassActivityResult(class)
		return
	end
